visual_description.subject: Mohan
visual_description.action: Mohan leans forward with sudden intensity in his duct-taped recliner, his face illuminated by the flickering blue light of the TV as he frantically mashes the buttons on his controller.
visual_description.setting: The center of the weathered, dimly lit living room.

visual_description.subject: Kabir and Vihaan
visual_description.action: Kabir sits rigidly in his chair, his hands folded self-consciously in his lap after retracting them from the lamp, while Vihaan slumps beside him, focused on peeling the label off his beer bottle with a smirk.
visual_description.setting: The corner of the dimly lit living room, framed by the warm, localized glow of the table lamp.
